findings.title: Keep the statutory substitute proof for foreign tax credits
findings.problem: The absolute statement that no foreign tax receipt/record means no credit omits2020No3§10 final paragraph. A taxpayer genuinely unable to supply the tax credential can use the foreign return(or authority tax notice) plus corresponding bank payment proof. The new XB Guide correctly preserves this possibility.

findings.title: Resolve missing facts instead of inventing income type or residence
findings.problem: Higher-tax classification and default non-resident treatment are not legal defaults in IIT Law1–2 or Regulations6. A domiciled resident does not become non-resident because day records are missing; an unknown category is not established by whichever computation is highest.
findings.repair: Keep both original ambiguity topics as stop-and-obtain-facts/referral rules. Any sensitivity scenarios must be labelled conditional and cannot be reported as the tax due.

findings.title: Do not borrow the six-taxes shortcut for CIT eligibility
findings.problem: The newly formed VAT general taxpayer shortcut using only prior-month headcount/assets is expressly restricted by2023No12§5 to the relief in its second paragraph(six taxes/two fees). The Guide places it in the CIT5% eligibility rules. CIT prepayment under2023No6§4 tests taxable income cumulatively too.
findings.repair: Remove the shortcut from CIT computations; retain it only as an explicitly separate six-taxes point if relevant. Keep all three CIT size tests at prepayment and annual settlement.

findings.title: Remove guessed10% withholding and distinguish dividend timing
findings.problem: The unclear-payment default still instructs10% withholding without establishing income character,source or establishment connection. Method/checklist repeat broad10% instructions. findings.title: Distinguish natural-person and corporate partners

findings.repair: Natural-person partners pay IIT; legal-person/other-organisation partners pay CIT. Keep specialist partnership allocation outside this Guide if desired.

findings.title: Do not require a list for every120% R&D claimant
findings.problem: 2023No44 has list-managed IC production/key-design enterprises and machine-tool enterprises,but IC equipment/materials/packaging/testing enterprises use the specified2021No9 conditions. findings.title: Correct the two unsupported VAT defaults

findings.title: Make imported-service input credit conditional on the taxpayer and use
